import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int totalComponents, totalPersons, modulus;
    static int[][] choose;
    static boolean[] computed2;
    static Result[] memo2;
    static boolean[][] computed1;
    static Result[][] memo1;

    static class Result {
        int totalWays, totalSum;
        Result() {
            this.totalWays = 0;
            this.totalSum = 0;
        }
        Result(int w, int s) {
            this.totalWays = w;
            this.totalSum = s;
        }
    }

    static int sumRange(int start, int end) {
        return (start + end) * (end - start + 1) / 2;
    }

    static Result compute2(int n) {
        if (n == 1) return new Result(2, 0);
        if (computed2[n]) return memo2[n];
        Result res = new Result(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int leftCount = i;
            int rightCount = n - i - 1;
            Result leftRes = (leftCount == 0) ? new Result(1, 0) : compute2(leftCount);
            Result rightRes = (rightCount == 0) ? new Result(1, 0) : compute2(rightCount);
            int ways = (leftCount + 1) + (rightCount + 1);
            int sumAdd = sumRange(0, leftCount) + sumRange(0, rightCount);
            int mlt = choose[leftCount + rightCount][leftCount];
            long tempWays = ((long)leftRes.totalWays * ways) % modulus;
            tempWays = (tempWays * rightRes.totalWays) % modulus;
            tempWays = (tempWays * mlt) % modulus;
            res.totalWays = (int)((res.totalWays + tempWays) % modulus);

            long sumPart1 = ((long)leftRes.totalSum * ways) % modulus;
            sumPart1 = (sumPart1 * rightRes.totalWays) % modulus;

            long sumPart2 = ((long)leftRes.totalWays * sumAdd) % modulus;
            sumPart2 = (sumPart2 * rightRes.totalWays) % modulus;

            long sumPart3 = ((long)leftRes.totalWays * ways) % modulus;
            sumPart3 = (sumPart3 * rightRes.totalSum) % modulus;

            long totalSum = (res.totalSum + sumPart1 + sumPart2 + sumPart3) % modulus;
            res.totalSum = (int)totalSum;
        }
        computed2[n] = true;
        memo2[n] = res;
        return res;
    }

    static Result compute1(int index, int count) {
        if (totalComponents - index == count) return compute2(count);
        if (computed1[index][count]) return memo1[index][count];
        Result res = new Result(0, 0);
        for (int i = index; i < totalComponents; ++i) {
            int leftCount = i - index;
            int rightCount = count - leftCount;
            if (rightCount < 0 || rightCount > totalComponents - i - 1) continue;
            Result leftRes = (i == index) ? new Result(1, 0) : compute2(leftCount);
            Result rightRes = (i + 1 == totalComponents) ? new Result(1, 0) : compute1(i + 1, rightCount);
            int mlt = choose[leftCount + rightCount][leftCount];
            long tempWays = ((long)leftRes.totalWays * rightRes.totalWays) % modulus;
            tempWays = (tempWays * mlt) % modulus;
            res.totalWays = (int)((res.totalWays + tempWays) % modulus);

            long sumPart1 = ((long)leftRes.totalSum * rightRes.totalWays) % modulus;
            sumPart1 = (sumPart1 * mlt) % modulus;

            long sumPart2 = ((long)leftRes.totalWays * rightRes.totalSum) % modulus;
            sumPart2 = (sumPart2 * mlt) % modulus;

            long totalSum = ((long)res.totalSum + sumPart1 + sumPart2) % modulus;
            res.totalSum = (int)totalSum;
        }
        computed1[index][count] = true;
        memo1[index][count] = res;
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int ncomp = sc.nextInt();
        int npers = sc.nextInt();
        int MOD = sc.nextInt();

        totalComponents = ncomp;
        totalPersons = npers;
        modulus = MOD;

        choose = new int[ncomp + 1][ncomp + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            choose[i][0] = 1;
            choose[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
                choose[i][j] = (choose[i - 1][j - 1] + choose[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        computed2 = new boolean[ncomp + 1];
        memo2 = new Result[ncomp + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            memo2[i] = new Result();
        }

        computed1 = new boolean[ncomp + 1][npers + 1];
        memo1 = new Result[ncomp + 1][npers + 1];

        Result result = compute1(0, npers);
        System.out.println(result.totalSum);
        sc.close();
    }
}
